metadata.name: Saboteur Class Tree
metadata.description: Trap and gadget focused class. Traps branch left, gadgets branch right, trunk center. Evasion woven throughout.

data.name: Preparation
data.description: Unlocks the Preparation resource. Preparation is generated by placing traps and gadgets, and whenever your traps or gadgets deal damage or trigger. It does not decay.

data.name: Hair Trigger
data.description: +10% trap trigger radius per point. At 5 points: Traps arm instantly upon placement instead of after a 1 second delay.

data.name: Overkill
data.description: When Preparation is generated while already at maximum, gain a stack of Overkill granting +5% damage. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 2 seconds.

data.name: Calculated
data.description: +5 maximum Preparation per point. At 6 points: Your Preparation cannot be reduced by enemy effects.

data.name: Slippery
data.description: +1% evasion chance per point. At 5 points: After successfully evading, gain 3 Preparation.

data.name: Light Footed
data.description: +5% of your current evasion chance per point while moving.

data.name: Bag of Tricks
data.description: +1 to maximum active traps and gadgets per point.

data.name: Volatile Mixture
data.description: +3% trap and explosive area of effect per point. At 5 points: Trap explosions leave a burning patch for 2 seconds dealing 10% of their damage per second.

data.name: Tinkerer
data.description: +3% gadget damage per point. At 6 points: Gadgets remain active 20% longer per point invested beyond 6.

data.name: On Your Toes
data.description: +2% damage per point for 3 seconds after successfully evading.

data.name: Prepared
data.description: +2% to all damage per point while above 50% of your maximum Preparation.

data.name: Trapsmith
data.description: +6% trap arming speed per point. At 4 points: Traps can be placed while moving without interrupting your movement.

data.name: Hair Wire
data.description: +10% trap trigger radius per point. At 4 points: Traps trigger 20% faster after detecting an enemy.

data.name: Volatile Casing
data.description: Each active trap on the battlefield reduces the trigger delay of all your other traps by 0.1 seconds per point, to a minimum of 0.1 seconds.

data.name: Ambush
data.description: +5% trap damage per point against enemies that have not yet triggered one of your traps.

data.name: Tripwire Network
data.description: +1 Preparation per point when a trap is triggered.

data.name: Minefield
data.description: +10% trap placement speed per point. At 6 points: Your maximum active trap limit is increased by 1.

data.name: Chain Reaction
data.description: When a trap is triggered, the nearest inactive trap within 8 meters is also triggered. At 4 points: This chain can occur once per second.

data.name: Saturation
data.description: Your evasion chance cap is increased by 5% for each active trap on the battlefield. Bonus evasion from this effect is not subject to the normal 60% cap.

data.name: Scattershot
data.description: When you deploy a trap, there is a 10% chance per point to spend 20 Preparation to deploy an additional trap at a random nearby location.

data.name: Overwhelming Presence
data.description: While at maximum active traps, you deal 50% more trap damage and trap trigger radius is doubled.

data.name: Hair Trigger Mechanism
data.description: +10% trap damage per point against the first enemy to trigger each trap.

data.name: Reinforced Housing
data.description: Traps are not consumed when triggered. Instead each subsequent trigger costs 15 Preparation, reduced by 1 Preparation per point. At 5 points: Each subsequent trigger deals 20% more damage than the last.

data.name: Delayed Fuse
data.description: Your traps have a 1 second additional arming delay but deal +15% damage per point and cannot be accidentally triggered by you or your gadgets during the arming period.

data.name: Marked Territory
data.description: Enemies that trigger a trap are marked for 5 seconds. Marked enemies take +5% increased damage per point from all sources.

data.name: Precision Placement
data.description: You may only have one active trap at a time. That trap gains +10% damage and +25% area of effect for each point of your maximum trap limit. Your maximum trap limit still benefits from all other sources.

data.name: Bigger Traps
data.description: +15% area of effect for traps per point.

data.name: Death Ground
data.description: +3% DoT damage per point applied by traps. At 6 points: Enemies standing in an area where a trap was triggered continue to take DoT damage for 3 seconds.

data.name: The Last Surprise
data.description: When your last active trap is triggered, it deals damage equal to the combined total damage of all traps triggered in the last 10 seconds. This can only occur once every 30 seconds.

data.name: Calculated Chaos
data.description: Your traps no longer have a maximum active limit. Instead each active trap beyond your normal maximum drains 5 Preparation per second. When you reach 0 Preparation all excess traps are immediately triggered simultaneously.

data.name: Field Engineer
data.description: +12% gadget deployment speed per point. At 4 points: Deploying a gadget does not interrupt any action you are currently performing.

data.name: Reinforced Frame
data.description: +8% gadget HP per point. At 5 points: When a gadget is destroyed, gain 10 Preparation.

data.name: Efficient Design
data.description: Each active gadget on the battlefield extends the active duration of all your other gadgets by 2 seconds per point.

data.name: Overcharge
data.description: When a gadget is deployed, it automatically consumes 2 Preparation per point to grant +5% damage and +5% HP per Preparation consumed.

data.name: Support Network
data.description: +3% gadget damage per point for each active trap on the battlefield. At 4 points: Active gadgets increase trap trigger radius by 10%.

data.name: Hot Deploy
data.description: +2% gadget attack speed per point for every 10 Preparation spent in the last 5 seconds.

data.name: Overclock
data.description: When a gadget is deployed, it passively drains 2 Preparation per point over 10 seconds, gaining +5% attack speed for each Preparation drained.

data.name: Volatile Construction
data.description: When a gadget is destroyed, it explodes dealing damage equal to +15% of its maximum HP per point to all nearby enemies.

data.name: Last Stand Protocol
data.description: When a gadget is reduced below 25% HP, it gains +8% attack speed and +8% damage per point for 5 seconds.

data.name: Rapid Deployment
data.description: Reduces the Preparation cost of all automatic gadget empowerment effects by 1 per point. At 6 points: Once every 15 seconds, your next gadget deployment costs no Preparation to empower.

data.name: Forward Operating Base
data.description: When you deploy a gadget, all other active gadgets are pulled to the most recent gadget.

data.name: Steady Power
data.description: Gadgets passively drain 1 Preparation per second while active. Your gadgets gain +4% damage per point for each point of Preparation above 50% of your maximum that you currently have.

data.name: Persistent Systems
data.description: +15% gadget HP regeneration per point per second while above 50% HP. At 4 points: Gadgets that survive for 20 seconds gain a permanent +10% damage stack.

data.name: Power Surge
data.description: Your gadgets build a charge over time, gaining one stack every 5 seconds up to a maximum of 5 stacks. At maximum stacks the gadget discharges, dealing 40% of its attack damage to all nearby enemies and resetting to 0 stacks.

data.name: Symbiosis
data.description: +2% gadget damage per point for each second a gadget has been continuously active up to a maximum of 20 seconds.

data.name: Redundant Systems
data.description: +5% chance per point that a gadget ignores damage from a hit entirely. At 6 points: When a gadget successfully ignores damage gain 5 Preparation.

data.name: Siege Mode
data.description: After remaining stationary for 3 seconds your gadgets gain +5% damage and +3% range per second stationary up to a maximum of 10 seconds. Moving more than 10 meters from any active gadget resets the bonus.

data.name: Combat Engineer
data.description: +8% gadget attack range per point for each active gadget on the battlefield. At 5 points: Gadgets can attack enemies through terrain within their range.

data.name: Coordinated Strike
data.description: Once per second when you hit an enemy your nearest active gadget also attacks that enemy dealing +8% bonus damage per point. At 4 points: This effect triggers for all active gadgets simultaneously.

data.name: Scrap and Rebuild
data.description: When a gadget is destroyed gain +5 Preparation per point and reduce the deployment cooldown of your next gadget by 2 seconds per point.

data.name: Mechanical Familiar
data.description: Your maximum active gadget limit is increased by 1. Your gadgets gain +1% bonus damage and +5% bonus HP per 10 Preparation.

data.name: Army of One
data.description: Each active gadget on the battlefield grants you +15% damage, +8% evasion chance, and +15 maximum Preparation. These bonuses update in real time as gadgets are deployed or destroyed.

data.name: First Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

data.name: Second Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

data.name: Third Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

data.name: Final Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

data.name: Ghost Step
data.description: +1% movement speed per point. At 5 points: While above 50% maximum Preparation, gain an additional 2% movement speed per point.

data.name: Razor Instincts
data.description: +3% evasion chance per point for 3 seconds after placing a trap or gadget.

data.name: Thin Air
data.description: You cannot be targeted while moving. Taking damage breaks this effect for 2 seconds.

data.name: Durable Modifications
data.description: +3% damage reduction per point. At 4 points: This damage reduction is doubled while above 50% maximum Preparation.

data.name: Pressure Sensitive
data.description: Traps apply a 20% slow per point to triggered enemies for 2 seconds. At 4 points: Enemies slowed by your traps also take +15% increased damage from all trap sources.

data.name: Sprung
data.description: +3% movement speed per point for 3 seconds after one of your traps is triggered.

data.name: Concealed
data.description: Your traps do not reveal your position when triggered. Additionally, the first enemy to enter each trap's trigger radius is rooted for 0.5 seconds per point before the trap fires.

data.name: Hair Wire Expertise
data.description: +8% trap attack speed and trigger rate per point for each unique trap type currently active on the battlefield.

data.name: Bleeding Ground
data.description: +10% chance per point that triggering a trap also applies a bleed stack to the triggering enemy.

data.name: Snap Back
data.description: +4% evasion chance per point while you have at least one active trap on the battlefield.

data.name: Callous Setup
data.description: +5% trap damage per point for every 10% of your evasion chance, up to a maximum of 60%.

data.name: Mobile Armory
data.description: +2% movement speed per point for each active gadget on the battlefield.

data.name: Overcautious
data.description: +4% evasion chance per point while any of your gadgets are under attack.

data.name: Synchronized
data.description: When one of your traps is triggered, the nearest active gadget immediately fires at the triggering enemy. When one of your gadgets is destroyed, the nearest active trap triggers instantly.

data.name: Emergency Protocol
data.description: +5% movement speed and +5% evasion per point for 5 seconds when a gadget is destroyed.

data.name: Calculated Risk
data.description: Your evasion chance is permanently set to 0%. All gadget damage is increased by 3% for every 1% of evasion chance you would have had from all sources.

data.name: Sentry Network
data.description: +2% evasion chance per point while within 15 meters of at least one active gadget.

data.name: Jury Rigged
data.description: Your gadgets cannot be destroyed. Instead, when they would be destroyed they are reduced to 1 HP and gain +100% damage and +100% attack speed until repaired to full HP. Can only trigger once per gadget per deployment.
